TCC Website Features 0.2.0: a new search page for the whole website

Searching from the main menu now opens a results page in the church's own look:
the three best matches first, then pages, upcoming events, sermons, Trinity Talk
and community groups in their own groups, with a "See all" page for long lists.

Search now reads sermon descriptions, speaker names and categories (Bible book,
topic, series) and community group details, not only titles and page text. It
tries the closest spelling when nothing is found, and leaves out past events.

A search limited to one kind of content (such as a sermon-only search) keeps
its own page. Switching the feature off puts the older results page back, and
the Features tab says so if anything the page depends on goes missing.
